item.title: Where Should MiBeeSteward Live: Soft Router, Host, or Center+Agent — Tested
item.description: I maintain an open-source network device management system (MiBee Steward — a single Go binary that discovers, identifies, and keeps a ledger of devices on the LAN). It runs directly on a router, or on an ordinary host in the network; when the network has multiple subnets there’s a third option: one center with a few lightweight agents. Which placement is right? I didn’t want to answer from impressions. With two subnets and a few idle devices on hand, I ran all three comparisons.
